items.heading: "Hotel Management Salary in India"
items.text: "Hotel management salary in India" is close to a meaningless single number, because the spread between a first-year trainee and a luxury-chain general manager is enormous, and most institute marketing quotes only the flattering end of it.

items.heading: Five
items.text: Five-star lobby photos, welcome garlands, international training tie-ups, and "a world of opportunities" brochure lines are the version of this career most 12th-grade students see before they choose it.

items.heading: Placement
items.text: Placement-day photos of the handful of toppers who land a branded management-trainee offer get shared across Instagram and parent WhatsApp groups, while the rest of the same batch quietly goes unmentioned.

items.heading: Course Marketing Leans Hard
items.text: Course marketing leans hard on five-star glamour and international postings, rarely on the fact that the first real job most graduates take is a rotating-shift trainee role on modest pay.
